text:
anya: Idea: 'Spotlight Postcards' — send a postcard + digital shoutout to teammates during performance cycle close. Physical card includes QR to prefill a SpotAwards nomination. Want to coordinate local printing, mailroom drop, and a tiny pop-up in each office for distribution week (Dec 12-16).
sasha: Love this. Can we standardize the nomination copy and include manager-approved lines?
raul: Local printers recommended for EU/APAC to avoid customs. I'll get 3 quotes.
natalie: I'll handle mailroom logistics and volunteer coord. Mailroom-bot: remind vendors need 48h notice.
mailroom-bot: External vendor deliveries require 48-hour logging and vendor contact details.
kyle: Budget question: how much can we spend per kit without extra approvals?
finance-bot: Up to $75 per kit pre-approved under 'culture-events/postcards' with PO. Above requires director sign-off.
legal: Note on privacy: collecting addresses needs consent; store for 30 days post-shipment. We'll provide template consent copy.
anya: Action items: Raul get quotes by Nov 10; Sasha draft postcard copy by Nov 8; Natalie run volunteer sign-up + mailroom slot request; I'll consolidate budget and request PO. Keep cards bilingual EN/ES for SF.
sasha: Draft posted in Confluence: short front line "Thanks for the lift" + QR linking to https://spotawards.internal/submit?tag=postcard.
raul: Quotes due — leaning local printers: SF, London, Singapore. Will share numbers tomorrow.
natalie: Volunteer pack date set Nov 30 13:00-16:00. Will post sign-up.
anya: Great. Let's keep the postcards light and manager-friendly. I'll lock plan after quotes + PO. :sparkles:
